contract.purpose: Persist exact owner/service-contract/Package/manifest/revision references and check current consistency in the same SQL UPDATE that performs the job claim CAS. This is not issuance or dispatch authority.
contract.experience: A future authorized operation keeps the exact saved permission revision. Removal/revocation/replacement blocks the old job; it does not borrow another same-owner Package grant or auto-upgrade to a new version.
contract.responsibility: ROCK implements strict reference parsing and fixture-only row coherence. The identity of a legitimate issuer/updater/revoker and their trust proof remains unresolved; no production writer is implemented.
contract.input: Exact nine-field input reference and fixture-only server job payload.toolPackageAuthorityReference with exactly9 correctly typed fields; SQL itself correlates schema, authority/revision, owner, issuer/claim/offer, Package/manifest and operation pins to the unaliased work_jobs row. This slot is not added to production WorkJob schema.
contract.output: Parameterized correlated EXISTS SQL+bindings or null. Valid inside unaliased UPDATE work_jobs; caller still owns authenticated owner/id/revision and active/pending CAS. Row coherence is not execution permission.
contract.states: Fixture active / revoked / superseded, explicit expiry, positive safe revision. Test-only writers use revision CAS and increment on change; old saved references cannot consume new revisions.
contract.persistence: Dedicated fixture SQL creates work_tool_package_authorities after existing migrations. File close/reopen preserves grant and job references. No production migration or automatic config import.
contract.failure: Owner/contract/Package/manifest/reference mismatch, missing/revoked/superseded/expired grant or parent contract, stale job/reference, and cancellation lose the same UPDATE with zero job revision change.
contract.recovery: Read back the original job/claim. A consumed or cancelled claim cannot replay. A legitimate new revision needs a separately stored new job reference; no silent upgrade or result-unknown resend.
contract.approval: Root status remains unbound_fixture_only; SQL schema accepts fixture_only roots and rejects invented verified/production roots. Authenticated owner, verified issuance root, current service scopes/session, Agent state, Connector exact one-use approval, Package review and pricing/budget checks remain separate required gates.
